service.method: SELECT SIAD.SMR_NUMBER , SIAD.SMR_STATUS , SIAD.ADD_DATE , SIAD.ADD_TIME , SIAD.ADD_USER_ID , SIAD.SUBJECT , CASE ${session.LANGUAGE} WHEN 'KO' THEN USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ELSE USMT.USER_NAME_ENG END AS ADD_USER_NAME , USMT.EMAIL , USMT.DEPT FROM SSIAD SIAD LEFT JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SIAD.ADD_USER_ID WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND nvl(SIAD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE IN ('001','002','008') AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER NOT IN ( SELECT SOURCE_NO FROM SSCGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SOURCE_NO IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY SIAD.SMR_NUMBER DESC

SELECT CODE.TEXT1 AS RESPONSIBILITY_NAME , USMT.USER_ID AS MANAGER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS MANAGER_NAME , USMT.EMAIL AS MANAGER_EMAIL FROM SUSMT USMT INNER JOIN SCODE CODE ON CODE.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CODE.TYPE = 'UX050' AND CODE.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND CODE.CODE = USMT.RESPONSIBILITY WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USMT.DEPT = ${DEPT}
